accepted.simpleMeaning: a long, still state in which a person or animal is not awake and does not move much
accepted.scope: This is not normal rest; it is a long, still condition caused by illness, cold or the needs of an animal's body.
examples: The sick animal lay in a sleep from which it did not wake.
Some animals fall into a long sleep when the weather turns cold.
branchCoverage: a torpid state resembling deep sleep -> a long, still state in which a person or animal is not awake and does not move much
accepted.lemmaPartition: sleep (1) n: the normal state of rest when you are not awake; sleep (2) n: a long, still state like sleep caused by illness or cold.
